description: Draws ONE option position at expiration from the legs described (call or put, long or short, strike, premium, contracts): one call or put, debit or credit spread, straddle, strangle, butterfly, iron condor; covered call with stock (shares, pricePaid: their cost, or today's price as an example); cash-secured put with cashSecured true. To compare positions, call once per position. Shows breakevens and a price slider. Uses only the inputs given; fetches no data and places no trade. Read-only. Shows an interactive panel in apps that support MCP Apps; always returns a text summary and a botspot.trade link.
